versions.changelog:
Initial release of doubao-web-image skill.

- Enables image generation via Doubao Web using Playwright for browser automation.
- Supports extracting core subject, style, scene, aspect ratio, and save path from user prompts.
- Allows using parameters for image aspect ratio (`--ratio=<value>`) and output path (`--output=<path>`).
- Operates in headless mode by default and provides feedback with image path or success confirmation.
